notes: Compound of อาหาร (food) and เย็น (evening).
In everyday conversation, people very often say ข้าวเย็น (evening rice) instead, and มื้อเย็น when referring to the meal time.

draftBefore.emotion: relaxed and appreciative, looking forward to the end of a long day
notes: อาหาร (aa-hǎan) means 'food' and เย็น (yen) means 'cool' or 'evening'. Together they refer specifically to the evening meal.
Unlike some other languages that use specific loanwords for dining, Thai uses this compound consistently to describe the main evening meal regardless of how fancy or simple it is.

senses.definition: The main evening meal, usually eaten after work or school.
